div.div:
// Test visibility
if (not visible)
return
sharedIndex = map[instance].sharedIndex
counter = atomicAdd(cullResults[sharedIndex], 1)
base = map[instance].visibleInstancesBaseIndex
write index = base + counter
visibleInstances[write index] = instance
